convention.source: scheduler path and scheduler-shaped name on a node that already has lexical or derived feature evidence

derived.localStrength: exact candidate-name token=1; then stable tie-break
derived.source: consonant skeleton derived from one ASCII run anchor of length >=5

fallback.localStrength: common/vendor/minified path=-2; test path=-1; otherwise=0; then stable tie-break
fallback.source: every candidate in the expanded pool

lexical.localStrength: name token=5; name substring=4; path token=3; path substring=2; signature substring=1; when enabled add 1/(1+matching-file-count); then stable tie-break
lexical.source: run anchor terms matched against candidate name/path/signature

relation.anchor: the matched target symbol evidence anchor
relation.localStrength: sum min(edge multiplicity,3) over distinct matched targets; then stable tie-break
relation.reason: highest-multiplicity outgoing edge kind and target name
relation.source: outgoing edge to a node whose symbol name has lexical evidence or whose name has derived evidence; path-only evidence is ineligible

seed.localStrength: query seed=2; incident neighbor=1; then descending local strength with relativePath/name/nodeId tie-break
seed.propagationPath: empty for the seed; one source->target:kind hop for a neighbor
seed.reason: query seed or seed-neighbor plus edge kind
seed.source: query seed or one incident graph edge
